resolution.note: KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE defaults to 6; test/cli/lane.test.ts starts 6 lanes concurrently and refuses the 7th.

title: The default lane budget is 6 live lanes
body: Evidence 2026-11-18: operator raised the lane cap to 6. KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE defaulted to 4 since the 2026-11-16 usage cut (t-ahsmyfp). Quota check (cswap list, 2026-11-18 10:08): team accounts 61-77% of the 7-day window, one at 99% resetting within 21h; Sonnet lane sessions cost about $0.15-0.19 each in the pilot. t-sy4qhg1 (39b72d9) removed the rebase-and-force-push rounds that more parallel PRs would have multiplied.
Outcome: `krn lane start` refuses only past 6 live lane worktrees by default (KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE still overrides), and the delivery-lead skill and lead rules state 6.
Proof: node --test test/cli/lane.test.ts: the default-budget case starts 6 lanes and refuses the 7th.
